payload.title: Require actual entry evidence before reopening an ambiguous experimental operation
payload.summary: Priority2 recovery correctness. run_operation marks IN_PROGRESS before call, but capture_operation increments invocations only after successful return. recover_known_preinvocation_failure accepts IN_PROGRESS plus zero invocations, absent result and a nonempty explanation as proof of non-entry. An independently authored entered-then-raised callable passes the reset guard with one actual entry. Existing ambiguous run_operation guard is safe until this manual reset is called. Actual original lexical AttributeError was documented before production entry, so this is synthetic exploitability, not historical retry corruption.
payload.benefit: Keep immutable Case0008 source/state intact. For a separately versioned future controller/recovery guard, distinguish scheduled, entered, returned and captured outcomes; consume allowance durably before operation entry and refuse uncertain effects. A special proven pre-call lookup failure must have external exact operation/execution/source-bound evidence and separate authorization, not prose alone. Negative tests: entered-then-raised, timeout/cancel, lost return checkpoint, forged foreign markers, nonempty explanation without evidence, exhausted recovery. Positive tests: authenticated pre-entry failure, captured return reuse, explicit generation-only allowance with no upstream retry. Never automatically retry ambiguous effects or claim rollback. Identify real future analysis/controller caller before promotion.
payload.uncertainty: Historical documented before-entry lookup and preauthorized one-call generation recovery remain distinct valid evidence. No generic execution framework, exactly-once claim, historical replay or new execution grant.
